part.text:
Fixed the XTRIM MINID bug by widening the stream ID delta variables from `int` to `int64_t` in `src/rax.c:2037`, preventing truncation when listpack entries have large millisecond deltas from the master ID.

Verified with the full `unit/type/stream` test suite: all tests pass.
